Nuevas pistas sobre la misteriosa desaparición de la colonia de Roanoke, en Carolina del Norte. Se trata de una localidad cuyos habitantes desaparecieron sin motivo aparente en la época colonial estadounidense, iniciando un enigma macabro.
Una de las criaturas más representativas de la Era de Hielo: el mamut peludo. Josh y su equipo buscan ADN para clonar a esta especie extinta.
Josh recupera muestras de hueso del cráter masivo de Batagay y obtiene los resultados del ADN para averiguar si el mamut lanudo recorrerá la tierra nuevamente.

Un joven diseña su primera casa en una zona rural de Illinois. Mientras lidian con la inclemencia del invierno del Medio Oeste, el chico y un amigo construyen, desde cero, la casa de sus sueños.

La familia Brown enfrenta un nuevo comienzo utilizando las habilidades y conocimientos que adquirió por más de 35 años en las tierras salvajes de Alaska.
Una arriesgada aventura en un laberinto de cavernas oscuras en las profundidades del Cañón de Chicamocha.
Un escape a través de los terrenos empinados de la selva de Ñambí, una de las más húmedas de Colombia.

Los niños descubren que en el zoo se hizo una inspección ambiental y se halló una supuesta contaminación. Según la inspectora, Mara, los animales serán trasladados y tal vez el zoo cierre... pero ella oculta un secreto. Con Melissa Vettore como Mara.

p.t: John Early: Now More Than Ever
p.d: John Early brings his unique blend of cutting commentary and pop star swagger to Roulette Intermedium in Brooklyn, N.Y.; in the style of a gritty 70s rockumentary, Early performs stand-up and explosive song covers from Britney to Neil Young.

One fine day, Paddington spots a pop-up book in an antique shop, the perfect present for his beloved aunt's 100th birthday. When a thief steals the prized book, Paddington embarks on a quest to unmask the culprit before her big celebration.

Jaime Reyes finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers.

A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.

Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.
As two clans descend on the scene of young twins' birthday, Greg Focker's moonlighting at a pharmaceutical company threatens to derail his position of trust with Jack, his uptight father-in-law.

Lisa, Hunter and Mitchell learn that their teenage daughters plan to lose their virginity on prom night. The worried parents soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.
A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.
Survivors (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone) of a zombie apocalypse use creative means to dispatch the undead as they make their way toward a rumored safe haven in Los Angeles.

A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.
Five highly competitive friends hit the ground running for their yearly, no-holds-barred game of tag -- risking their necks, their jobs and their relationships to take one another down.

Aspiring club promoters and best buds Damon and Kevin need a huge windfall to make their problems go away. They decide to host the party of the year at an exclusive mansion, which just happens to belong to none other than NBA superstar LeBron James.

Something bad happened to Agnes, but life goes on for everyone else. When a beloved friend on the brink of a major milestone visits, Agnes starts to realize just how stuck she's been, and begins to work through how to move forward.

Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows Spinal Tap as they prepare for a reunion concert. Joined by Paul McCartney and Elton John, they wrestle with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in rock 'n' roll history.

Fitment issues in the engine bay leave the entire shop scratching their heads; Joe has big plans for the '65 Nova, but a small space to work with.

A customer wants to surprise his wife with major upgrades to her '68 Corvette convertible, but working with the fiberglass body soon brings on headaches that threaten both the car and the shop to crack under the pressure.

It's finally time to fire up the Model T, before some extensive bodywork that will keep Kalev busy for a while. The Crown Vic gets a visit from her owners, before Greg goes on her final road test. Dave and Janice visit the Lane Motor Museum in Nashv.
Dave and the crew head to the Jeep Invasion to visit a family-owned company that does amazing off-road uplifts and complete builds, and John makes sense of hybrid systems.

The legendary '68 Dodge Charger General Mayhem gets stripped of its 707-hp Hellcat engine and all the related electronics; Freiburger and Dulcich vow to take it from the drag strip setup back to its motorhome 440-powered V8 and gravel-chucking roots.

The COVID-350-powered, six-speed 1956 Chevy Bel Air may sport 500 hp, but is far from perfection; Freiburger and Dulcich bring it closer to reaching their goals with some weight reduction, suspension modifications and a new 9-inch rear end.

Willie B and Kevin unveil an incredible wide-body C10 that could be their most ambitious project ever. The goal is to transform it into a 1,000-hp street machine, combining cutting-edge engineering, premium aftermarket parts and show-stopping style.

Amid the cornfields of Michigan, Derek discovers a '37 Chevy Deluxe he wants to drive to GM headquarters in Detroit; but it's been off the road for over 20 years and is going to put up a fight to make the 150-mile journey.
Derek and Sean Bieri head back to Zweifel Motors in the Black Hills of South Dakota to revive an Oldsmobile station wagon Derek has been eyeing for 16 years.

Steve Dulcich returns along with the long-lost Vanishing Paint Challenger; Derek and Steve pull out VP's automatic 727 in favor of a manual T56 and set their sights for a local road course, where they take on a last-generation Challenger RT.

The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.
The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

Un mundo donde la comida cobra vida en proporciones gigantescas. Cinco niños se embarcan en aventuras inolvidables llenas de diversión.
Anya usa una bola de cristal mágica para adivinar el futuro en la feria de la ciudad. Después de que predice el encarcelamiento de Jenny, una enorme burbuja de jabón cae sobre Jenny y Anya.
Por error, Lili entrega un cuadro, que ella no pintó, como su tarea escolar. La obra gana un concurso, pero Lili sabe que no puede aceptar el premio.
Rosie, una niña entusiasta, inteligente y positiva, con su pintoresco grupo de amigos, se embarca en un divertido viaje de descubrimientos para aprender valores importantes y lecciones de vida.
Lili quiere ayudar a Sam a preparar su viaje a China, pero Sam está más interesado en su nueva tableta.
Los amigos Zorro, Conejo, Tejón, Ratón y muchos otros viven juntos en el bosque y exploran las cuatro estaciones. Siempre hay algo nuevo que descubrir en el bosque, con el clima y entre ellos.
Lu y Bu escuchan un cuento para dormir sobre una princesa mariquita.
